content.rendered:
PacketFest 2025 has been a great success. About 110 people, coming from more than 10 (European and overseas) countries, met in Zürich and attended the conference organized by ntop with support from Switch, AnyWeb, and Leutert NetServices. It was a three-day event where the ntop and Wireshark communities met to discuss network traffic visibility and cybersecurity.

It was a great pleasure to have on stage many packet experts including Gerald Combs (Wireshark creator), Kelley Misata (president of OISF), and Thomas Graf (IETF chair), this in addition to the ntop core team.

Those who have missed the event can download the presentation slides from this page.

PS. Yes we’re planning future PacketFest editions. Shall you be interested in supporting the event or being a speaker, please contact us.
